text: Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group Co., Ltd. is a first-level municipal state-owned enterprise established by the Jinan municipal government in June 2017.
short: Jinan Culture & Tourism Group is a Jinan municipal state-owned enterprise.

source.name: 山东人才就业网 (Shandong Talent Employment Network): 2026年济南文旅发展集团有限公司校园招聘公告（20人）
source.quote: 济南文旅发展集团有限公司(以下简称集团)是济南市政府2017年6月批准设立的市属一级国有企业
source.note: Translation: 'Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group Co., Ltd. (the Group) is a first-level municipal state-owned enterprise established with the approval of the Jinan municipal government in June 2017.' The group's own 2026 campus recruitment announcement.

additionalSources.name: 搜狐/金融界 (Sohu / JRJ.com, via 经济导报 Economic Herald): 济南文旅集团换帅！总经理王学军接任法定代表人，白冰退出董事长岗位
additionalSources.quote: 济南文旅发展集团有限公司是济南市政府于2017年6月批准设立的市属一级国有企业，注册资本为30亿元
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group Co., Ltd. is a first-level municipal state-owned enterprise established with the approval of the Jinan municipal government in June 2017, with registered capital of RMB 3 billion.' The same page's shareholding sentence (Jinan SASAC 93.19%, largest shareholder and actual controller; Shandong Caixin 6.81%) was checked too, but no second independent publisher for that sentence was found, so the rating rests on this municipal-SOE statement.
